title: Plus Size Knotted Crepe Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Designed with comfort and confidence in mind, this plus size dress offers a beautifully balanced fit. The ruched knot-front detail creates a defined waistline, while the embroidered mesh bodice adds texture and sophistication. Cap sleeves provide light arm coverage, and the front slit allows for effortless movement throughout the celebration. Perfect for weddings, black-tie events, and formal family occasions.


Size Tip: The waist and hip areas have high stretch, but the bust area has no stretch. If your measurements vary between sizes, prioritize your bust measurement when choosing your size.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor-length.


Sleeve Style: Cap sleeve.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises crepe.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
